description: Manual switch, 4HP, sending one of three inputs to a single output

params.text: Each press moves to the next input, stepping through the three in turn and wrapping back to the first

inputs.text: Passed to the OUT jack while the first of the three positions is picked
Passed to the OUT jack while the second of the three positions is picked
Passed to the OUT jack while the third of the three positions is picked

outputs.text: Carries whichever of the three inputs the SELECT button has picked

notes: one channel only; a polyphonic cable at an input passes its first channel and drops the rest
